sessionStart.bash: r=$(cat "$HOME/.plancia/root.txt" 2>/dev/null); if [ ! -f "$r/fcore/auto.py" ]; then a=$(find "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins" "$HOME/.vscode/agent-plugins" "$HOME/.claude/plugins" -maxdepth 7 -path '*/fcore/auto.py' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); r=${a%/fcore/auto.py}; fi; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/factory.py" ]; then exec python3 "$r/factory.py" hook SessionStart --plugin; fi
sessionStart.powershell: $r=''; $t="$HOME\.plancia\root.txt"; if (Test-Path $t) { $r=(Get-Content $t -Raw).Trim() }; if (-not $r -or -not (Test-Path "$r\fcore\auto.py")) { $r=(Get-ChildItem "$HOME\.copilot\installed-plugins","$HOME\.vscode\agent-plugins","$HOME\.claude\plugins" -Recurse -Depth 6 -Filter auto.py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Directory.Name -eq 'fcore' -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $_.Directory.Parent.FullName 'factory.py')) } | Select-Object -First 1).Directory.Parent.FullName }; if ($r) { py "$r\factory.py" hook SessionStart --plugin }
